card.title: By parts and partial fractions — the method chooser

rows.label: Concept
rows.text: Integration reverses differentiation (+C for the lost constant). Three methods cover the syllabus: substitution (spot the inner function and its derivative), by parts (∫u·dv = uv − ∫v·du for products — ILATE picks u: Inverse/trig, Logarithmic, Algebraic, Trig, Exponential), partial fractions (split rational functions into summable pieces). Definite integrals add properties (limits swap, split, symmetry, King property) and measure area: under one curve, between two curves.

rows.label: Formula
rows.text: ∫u·dv = uv − ∫v·du (ILATE order)  ·  substitution: f(g(x))·g′(x) → f(u)  ·  partial: P(x)/Q(x) → A/(x−a) + B/(x−b) + …  ·  definite: ∫ₐᵇ = −∫ᵦᵃ · split · even/odd symmetry · King: ∫ₐᵇf = ∫ₐᵇf(a+b−x)  ·  area = ∫|top − bottom| between intersection points

rows.label: Conditions
rows.text: By parts needs a splittable product with an integrable dv. Partial fractions need proper fractions first (divide if degree numerator ≥ denominator) with factorable denominators. Definite symmetry tricks need symmetric limits (−a to a). Area between curves needs the correct top/bottom order per interval (split at crossings).

rows.label: Special cases
rows.text: ∫x·eˣdx = (x−1)eˣ (parts once). ∫dx/(x²−a²) partial-splits to logarithms. Trig powers reduce via identities (sin² → (1−cos2x)/2). King property dissolves symmetric definite integrals (∫₀^π x·sinx/(1+cos²x)dx classics). Area under y = x² from 0 to 2: [x³/3] = 8/3.

rows.label: Solved
rows.text: ∫x·eˣdx: ILATE picks u = x, dv = eˣdx → du = dx, v = eˣ → x·eˣ − ∫eˣdx = (x−1)eˣ + C. Area between y = x² and y = x: intersect at 0, 1; top is x → ∫₀¹(x − x²)dx = [x²/2 − x³/3]₀¹ = 1/6.

rows.label: Limitation
rows.text: Not every elementary function integrates elementarily (e^(−x²), sin x/x have no closed forms — numerical methods take over). ILATE is a heuristic with rebels (cyclic integrals need algebra, not order). Area formulas assume continuous bounded curves between limits.

rows.label: Derivation
rows.text: By parts from the product rule: d(uv) = u·dv + v·du → integrate → ∫u·dv = uv − ∫v·du. Substitution from the chain rule read backward. Partial fractions from algebra: undetermined coefficients A, B forced by identity. Definite properties from limit arithmetic + geometric symmetry of even/odd graphs.

rows.label: Shortcut
rows.text: Method radar: inner function + its derivative → substitution; product of unlike types → parts (ILATE); rational function → partial fractions. Definite: check symmetry and King before computing. Area: intersections first, top-minus-bottom second.

rows.label: Board question
